description: This file defines an abstract base class for registries that map commands to exceptions, including methods for constructor initialization, exception retrieval, and fallback handling.

classes.name: AbstractCommandToExceptionRegistry
classes.description: An abstract class implementing CommandToExceptionRegistry that maps command types to exceptions using strategies and provides fallback mechanism.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback behavior when no specific exception mapping is found for a command.

methods.name: exceptionFrom
methods.description: Retrieves or computes the exception for a given command based on its type.
